name: Search Visibility (AI & GEO Audit)
author: Abuzer

sections.description:
Search Visibility is a unified on-site visibility auditor and task manager, not an SEO generator suite and not another llms.txt-only tool.

It inspects your public WordPress site, unifies SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) diagnostics, detects analytics tags, checks search engine indexability, analyzes AI crawler behavior, and turns all findings into a prioritized, actionable task checklist (open, fix, mark done). You keep your favorite SEO plugins (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, or SEOPress) for titles, canonicals, sitemaps, and schema generation.

The plugin measures on-site readiness and crawler visibility. It does not guarantee rankings, citations, traffic, or inclusion in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, or any other third-party product.

Unified Visibility Dashboard

Search Visibility consolidates 8 core visibility facets into a single, cohesive interface:

  1. Overview: High-level SEO health score, GEO readiness score (0–100), active open issue counts, and last audit timestamps.
  2. SEO Audit: Inspects public pages for title lengths, meta descriptions, heading structures (H1–H3), image alt text, canonical links, indexability directives, and structured data schemas.
  3. Analytics Setup: Safely detects GA4 (G-...) and GTM (GTM-...) tags, flags duplicate installations, and documents verification limitations without executing third-party scripts.
  4. Search Engine Setup: Inspects robots.txt directives, XML sitemaps, indexability flags, provides a manual Google Search Console (GSC) checklist, and connects read-only GSC property data where authorized.
  5. AI Crawler Insights: Visualizes actual crawler traffic from Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics, imported server access logs, or an optional origin logger. Displays request distributions, top requested URLs, status code breakdowns (200s, 301s, 403s, 404s), and reverse-DNS verification status.
  6. AI Crawler Accessibility: RFC 9309 robots.txt compliance checker and bounded diagnostic HTTP tests to verify whether major AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, etc.) appear able to reach public content.
  7. Recommendations Engine: Prioritizes issues across all audit domains (High, Medium, Low, Info) with clear evidence, rationale, and direct edit links. Supports marking items resolved.
  8. Reports & Exports: One-click clean, printable/downloadable executive HTML reports and structured CSV data exports.
  9. Integrations & Privacy: Transparent control panel for connected services (GSC, Cloudflare, GreeLogix), authorization scopes, explicit consent controls, disconnect actions, and complete data deletion.

What this plugin does

  • Run an on-demand GEO Audit using local WordPress APIs and stored content.
  • Calculate a heuristic GEO Readiness Score (0–100).
  • Run an on-demand SEO Scan of public pages for essential metadata, headings, and images.
  • Run an on-demand Analytics Setup check to detect GA4 and GTM installations without tracking.
  • Run an on-demand AI Crawler Accessibility check with simulated user-agent tests and robots.txt analysis.
  • Monitor recognized AI and search crawlers via Cloudflare Analytics (read-only token) or Server Log Upload (Nginx / Apache combined log format).
  • Optional curated llms.txt file generation with privacy protections for non-public content.
  • Connect optional read-only Google Search Console property statistics.
  • Download printable Executive HTML Reports and CSV Exports of recommendations.
  • Detects active SEO suites (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress).
  • Optional post-scan admin email notification via wp_mail (off by default).

What this plugin does not do

  • No OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or other AI API keys required.
  • No mandatory third-party accounts or SaaS registrations.
  • No hidden tracking, telemetry, or third-party pixels.
  • No automatic content or metadata overwrites.
  • No continuous background scans stalling server performance.

Privacy and External Services

  • Core features operate entirely on-site. All scans and inspections are strictly local and on-demand.
  • Settings and cached transients are stored locally in WordPress options.
  • Optional Google Search Console Integration: Connects only if explicitly authorized by an administrator via OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow. Accesses read-only Search Console property data directly from Google APIs (https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly). Tokens are AES-256 encrypted and stored in local WordPress options; no data is shared with third parties. Admins can disconnect at any time to purge credentials.
  • Optional Cloudflare Analytics Provider: Connects only if explicitly configured with an administrator-provided read-only Cloudflare API token. Queries Cloudflare’s GraphQL API (https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/graphql) directly from your server to fetch aggregated bot and crawler analytics. Tokens are AES-256 encrypted and masked in the admin UI. Admins can disconnect and delete credentials at any time.
  • Optional GreeLogix Product Insights: Opt-in, consent-first integration disabled by default. Transmits only explicitly consented categories (minimal feature adoption events, sanitized website technical environment, diagnostic scores, or voluntary marketing inquiries) over HTTPS to a configured GreeLogix webhook endpoint. Zero tracking or telemetry by default; consent can be revoked and stored integration data purged at any time.
  • Deleting the plugin runs uninstall.php and removes all plugin data, options, user meta, and cached transients.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the firdousi-search-visibility directory to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Search Visibility.
  3. Open Search Visibility → Dashboard to access the unified 8-section overview.
  4. Run an on-demand GEO Audit or SEO Scan.
  5. (Optional) Connect Cloudflare, import access logs, or connect Google Search Console from Integrations & Privacy.
sections.faq:
Does this guarantee ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI visibility?

No. Scores and tasks describe on-site readiness and crawler accessibility only.

Does this plugin send my content to an AI service?

No. Audits run locally on your WordPress site.

Does it replace Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO?

No. It acts as an independent auditor and checklist manager to help you identify and resolve visibility issues within WordPress or your chosen SEO suite.

What is llms.txt?

A Markdown file served at /llms.txt listing curated public URLs for AI crawlers. Generating and serving it is completely optional.

How does AI Crawler Insights work?

Crawler Insights aggregates request data from one of two sources:
1. Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API using a user-provided, read-only API token.
2. Uploaded server access logs (Nginx or Apache combined log format) parsed locally with query-string redaction.
WordPress does not attempt to read arbitrary server log paths directly.

Are any analytics or telemetry sent automatically?

No. The plugin includes zero telemetry by default. The optional GreeLogix Product Insights integration is strictly opt-in and consent-first, with granular checkboxes for adoption events, technical environment, diagnostics, and voluntary contact.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added unified 8-section Website Visibility Dashboard (Overview, SEO Audit, Analytics Setup, Search Engine Setup, AI Crawler Insights, AI Crawler Accessibility, Recommendations, Reports, and Integrations & Privacy).
  • Added AI Crawler Insights module supporting Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics and server access-log import (Nginx & Apache formats) with automatic query string parameter redaction and deduplication.
  • Added AI Crawler Accessibility diagnostic page with RFC 9309 robots.txt analysis and bounded simulated crawler HTTP checks.
  • Added consolidated Recommendations Engine with cross-domain priority sorting (High/Medium/Low/Info) and persistent task resolution tracking.
  • Added executive printable/downloadable HTML reports and structured CSV data exports.
  • Added optional Google Search Console OAuth 2.0 read-only integration.
  • Added optional GreeLogix Product Insights consent-first integration with granular sharing controls and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks.
  • Hardened security across all modules: AES-256 credential encryption, strict SSRF bounds, and LibXML XXE hardening.
  • Resolved PHP 8.4 fputcsv() deprecation notices and ensured full WordPress VIP coding standards compliance.

1.0.2

  • Updated display name to Search Visibility (AI & GEO Audit).
  • Cleaned up in-admin branding and labels.

1.0.1

  • Public slug: firdousi-search-visibility.

1.0.0

  • First public release: on-demand GEO and SEO audits, task lists, optional llms.txt.
